mapper.select: SELECT notice_id, title, content, writer, view_count, is_pinned, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM notice WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT notice_id, title, content, writer, view_count, is_pinned, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM notice WHERE notice_id = #{notice_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice ( title, content, writer, view_count, is_pinned, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, 0, 0, 0, SYSDATETIME(), SYSDATETIME() )
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE notice_id = #{notice_id}
UPDATE notice SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE notice_id = #{notice_id}
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 5 notice_id, title, created_at FROM notice ORDER BY created_at DESC
